text: the guard is gone; the DR is still accepted when supplied, and is echoed only when present. The cashier modal no longer lists the slip number in `returnMissing()` and omits `dr_number` from the payload when blank, so a blank field can never look like a real receipt. Acceptance: `tests/daily_ledger_consignee_return_no_dr_test.php` (6 assertions, failed on the pre-change tree, passes now).
